info.longName: FT Cboe Vest S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats Target Income ETF

funds_data.description: The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of a hypothetical BuyWrite strategy on constituents of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats Index, which targets companies that are currently members of the S&P 500 ® Index.
